title: Yellowed Smoky Syrian Chicken Legs Roast
description: A smoky and shattering Syrian dish featuring chicken legs, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is shojin-friendly and salt-baked to perfection, the chicken is marinated in a mixture of olive oil, lemon juice, and spices before being roasted to a golden brown
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, paprika, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and sumac
Add the chicken legs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and arrange the chicken legs on it
Bake the chicken for 30 minutes, then reduce the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired
